title: VISTA: A Versatile Interactive User Simulation Toolkit for Agent Evaluation
title_zh: VISTA：用于 Agent 评估的通用交互式用户模拟工具包
abstract_en: Evaluation remains a critical bottleneck for interactive agent development. Existing evaluation methods often rely on static benchmarks, which fail to capture the dynamic, multi-step nature of agentic behavior and struggle to expose meaningful failure modes. While user-simulation-based evaluation offers a promising alternative, existing simulation frameworks suffer from two major limitations. First, they provide limited mechanisms for evaluating the quality and comprehensiveness of simulated interactions, making it difficult to assess whether a simulator sufficiently explores an agent's capabilities and failure modes. Second, most frameworks are restricted to either UI-only actions or API-only actions, limiting their ability to model the full range of realistic user behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose VISTA, a Versatile Interactive user Simulation Toolkit for Agent evaluation. Our toolkit includes a suite of six metrics for measuring the realism, capability coverage, and interaction effectiveness of simulated interactions. In addition, we develop a hybrid user simulator that integrates both UI-based interactions and API-based interactions, enabling more realistic and comprehensive evaluation across diverse interactive environments. We evaluate VISTA in e-commerce shopping and education customer service settings and demonstrate that it produces more realistic and comprehensive evaluations than existing methods.
abstract_zh: 交互式 Agent 的评估仍是其开发中的关键瓶颈。现有评估方法多依赖静态基准，难以刻画 Agent 行为中动态、多轮的交互特性，也不易暴露有意义的失败模式。基于用户模拟（user simulation）的评估是一种有前景的替代方案，但现有框架存在两类主要局限：一是缺少衡量模拟交互质量与覆盖全面性的机制，难以判断模拟器是否充分探索了 Agent 的能力边界与失败模式；二是多数框架仅支持 UI-only 或 API-only 行为，无法建模真实用户更丰富的交互方式。为此，论文提出 VISTA，一个用于 Agent 评估的通用交互式用户模拟工具包。VISTA 提供六类指标，用于衡量模拟交互的真实性、能力覆盖度与交互有效性；同时提出混合用户模拟器，整合 UI-based 与 API-based 交互，以在多样化交互环境中实现更真实、更全面的评估。作者在电商购物与教育客服场景中评估 VISTA，结果显示其相比既有方法能产生更真实且覆盖更全面的评估。
key_points_zh: 论文指出静态 benchmark 难以评估交互式 Agent 的动态多步行为，也难以系统暴露失败模式。
VISTA 提供六项评估指标，覆盖模拟交互的真实性（realism）、能力覆盖度（capability coverage）与交互有效性（interaction effectiveness）。
方法核心是混合用户模拟器，同时支持 UI-based interactions 与 API-based interactions，更贴近真实用户在复杂环境中的行为。
在 e-commerce shopping 与 education customer service 两类场景中，VISTA 相比现有用户模拟评估方法展现出更高的真实性和更全面的能力探索。
该工具包面向 Agent evaluation，可作为替代或补充静态基准的交互式评估框架。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong interactive user-simulation toolkit for agent evaluation with clear harness-level observability value.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一个很有价值的交互式用户仿真评测工具，对代理平台观测与评估意义明显。
